questions.q: What did the angel tell Zacharias his wife Elizabeth would have?
options: A son, to be named John
questions.evidence: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard, and your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John

questions.q: Which angel was sent to Mary in Nazareth?
questions.evidence: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee, named Nazareth, to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house

questions.q: Where did Mary lay her newborn son?
questions.evidence: She wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn

questions.q: After how many days did his parents find the boy Jesus in the temple?
questions.evidence: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them, and asking them questions

questions.q: In the parable, who stopped to help the man beaten by robbers?
questions.evidence: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion

questions.q: In the parable, which son wasted his property in a far country?
questions.evidence: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living

questions.q: What was the name of the beggar laid at the rich man's gate?
questions.evidence: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was laid at his gate, full of sores

questions.q: What did Zacchaeus climb to see Jesus?
questions.evidence: He ran on ahead, and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way

questions.q: Where did Jesus tell the criminal he would be with him that day?
questions.evidence: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise

questions.q: To which village were the two walking when the risen Jesus joined them?
questions.evidence: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem
